diagnosis: When a frame is dropped, the write pointer wr_ptr_cur_reg is rolled back to wr_ptr_reg but wr_addr_reg is updated to the rolled-back pointer. If a tlast beat arrives during the drop sequence, the logic commits the frame by advancing wr_ptr_reg to wr_ptr_cur_next (which equals wr_ptr_reg), thereby publishing the dropped frame's data. The extra m_axis_tvalid cycles occur because this committed but unwanted frame remains in memory and is later read out.
